prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively mountain campsite scene. On the left stands a tall pine tree with dark green needles. Next to the tree sits a blue tent with its flap open. A man in a red scarf stands beside the tent holding a metal mug. A woman in a yellow hat points at a map spread on a wooden table. The table is located in the center of the composition. A brown dog lies under the table chewing a bone. To the right of the table, a boy in a striped shirt looks at a campfire. The campfire crackles with orange flames and grey logs. A girl in a pink jacket roasts a marshmallow over the fire. Behind her, a large grey bear watches from the treeline. A ranger in a green uniform stands near the bear holding a clipboard. In the foreground, a silver kettle sits on a portable stove. A stack of firewood rests next to the stove. A black backpack leans against a large grey boulder. The boulder is positioned on the far right edge. A white owl perches on a branch above the owl. A fox peeks out from behind a bush near the fox. A child in a blue coat sleeps in a hammock strung between two trees. The hammock sways gently in the breeze. A lantern hangs from a branch above the lantern. There is no snow on the ground. There is no vehicle visible in the scene. There is no text or signage anywhere.
